research.facts:
Antonelli Championship Clinching Race
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Kimi Antonelli leads Drivers' Championship by 123 points over George Russell ✓ (Al Jazeera, RacingNews365, multiple sources)
- Russell is P2 at 242 points; Hamilton P3 at 241 points ✓ (from Oct 31 pipeline confirmed data)
- Antonelli needs P9 or better to clinch IF Russell or Hamilton wins ✓ (multiple sources: RacingNews365, LBC, GPblog)
- If neither Russell nor Hamilton wins, Antonelli is champion regardless of position ✓ (multiple sources)
- A win today would make Antonelli the youngest F1 champion in history (born 2006) ✓ (MEDIUM — from pipeline context; champion at ~19 years old)
- Race is Sunday, November 1, 2026 ✓
- Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, Mexico City ✓
**MEDIUM confidence:**
- "9 wins in 2026" stat for Antonelli — from Oct 31 pipeline, not re-verified today
- Exact youngest champion age record — needs primary source verification; Verstappen was 24y3d; Vettel 23y134d
